files.role: Grouped, collapsible source chooser. Full replacement of Sprint01 flat-list implementation.

methods.name: SourceChooser
methods.purpose: Groups sources by application field (preserving SQL-defined order), renders one collapsible section per group collapsed by default, renders checkbox-style source rows within each expanded group, disables unchecked rows when selectedCount >= maxSelected, calls onToggle on source row click.

private_objects.name: SourceGroup
private_objects.purpose: Internal grouping type: { application: string; sources: SourceListRow[] }. Used only within this file to organize the flat sources list before rendering.

props_contract.onToggle: (application: string, source_label: string, selected: boolean) => void

files.role: New component. Fetches events for 1..4 selected sources in parallel and renders a transposed year grid with per-source swimlane sub-rows.

methods.name: SwimlaneRenderer
methods.purpose: Fetches events for each source in parallel on mount and when sources changes. Renders a transposed grid: rows=weeks (~52), columns=days-of-week (Mon..Sun). For each week row, renders one swimlane sub-row per source. Month labels at left margin on first row of each month. Source labels at left margin. Intensity classes heat-0..heat-4. Shows Skeleton until all fetches resolve. Shows per-source ErrorCard on fetch failure. Calls onDayClick only for cells with value > 0.

private_objects.name: buildEventMap
private_objects.purpose: Converts CalendarEventRow[] into a Map<string, CalendarEventRow> keyed by date string ('YYYY-MM-DD'). Used only within SwimlaneRenderer.

private_objects.name: getIntensityClass
private_objects.purpose: Maps a numeric value (0..100) to a CSS class string: 0 -> 'heat-0', 1-25 -> 'heat-1', 26-50 -> 'heat-2', 51-75 -> 'heat-3', 76-100 -> 'heat-4'. Used only within SwimlaneRenderer.

private_objects.name: buildWeekGrid
private_objects.purpose: Builds the ordered list of week start dates and month boundary markers for the current calendar year. Returns a structure that SwimlaneRenderer uses to render week rows with correct month labels. Used only within SwimlaneRenderer.

files.role: Top-level calendar page. Significant changes: remove activeSrc, introduce selectedSources derived from sources, route to SwimlaneRenderer, remove HeatmapRenderer reference.

methods.name: CalendarPage
methods.purpose: Fetches sources on mount. Maintains sources: SourceListRow[] state. Derives selectedSources = sources.filter(s => s.selected). Passes selectedCount=selectedSources.length and maxSelected=4 to SourceChooser. Renders SwimlaneRenderer when selectedSources.length > 0, passing selectedSources and handleDayClick. Renders DayDetailView with selectedDay. Shows prompt text when selectedSources is empty. Retains loading, error, and empty-state behaviors.

methods.name: handleToggle
methods.purpose: Calls PATCH /api/chronicle/calendar/sources. On success updates sources state. On failure rolls back optimistic update and surfaces error.

methods.name: handleDayClick
methods.purpose: Sets selectedDay state, causing DayDetailView to render with the clicked row.

removal_notes: Remove all imports and references to HeatmapRenderer
